copy_note: Same task as p14-larger-ledgercheck-v4: spec content, studio cases, extended cases and reference are unchanged; only benchmark_id, these expectations and how the pass bars are checked differ. Owner decision 2026-11-14 (ADR-0105): in-app qualification uses its own frozen version because the p14-larger-ledgercheck-v4 pass bars name a Linux-only script, and frozen pass bars are never reworded.
declared_scale: Entry point plus a package of at least 3 modules with an internal API, one builder task, 6 automated checks with 10 studio cases (5 held out), plus 21 extended held-out cases and a structure check run after the build

expected_requests.note: A repair round is measured, not required

expected_cost_usd: 0.00 on a plan-backed route (plan_roles). Any metered route is out of this packet
one_build_per_attempt: Each attempt is its own product and build in the studio qualification harness, from this spec.json content exactly (no catalog run, selection or spec is created)
qualified_at_declared_scale_when: All 3 attempts meet every pass bar. Fewer is recorded as k of 3 and is not qualified; nothing is re-run to replace a failure
invalid_attempt_when: An infrastructure fault outside the roles stops the attempt before a verdict: a role request that got no answer (network, provider, rate or usage limit, sign-in, token or timeout), a request the studio refused at admission (an earlier request with an unknown outcome or one still running, the daily cap, a lost sign-in), a worker that did not finish a case, or a studio restart. It is recorded with its cause, and each attempt may be replaced at most once. A role answer the role itself caused to end without the contract (output too long or incomplete, out of turns, a model other than the one asked for, or that model refused) is a failed attempt, not an infrastructure fault
pass_bar_per_attempt: Studio build reaches verified_candidate: QA passes every frozen studio case, held-out ones included, in the isolation worker, and the reviewer approves with no findings (the studio's own rule)
Requests used are at most the plan's max_calls (6)
The exported package is verified by the studio: every frozen case re-run on the extracted archive in the isolation worker
All 21 extended cases pass on the exported package, run by the studio in the isolation worker with the studio case rule (exact output and exit status)

Structure check passes (studio check, packages/executor/src/recipe-scoring.ts, the rule of v4's grader): src/ledger has parse.py, rules.py and report.py, each with a top-level def statement, and src/main.py imports from ledger (from ledger... import, or ledger among the names of an import) anywhere; text in strings and comments is not code
measure_and_record: requests used and repair rounds used
wall time from start to verdict
reviewer verdict and the build reason
package manifest SHA-256 and archive SHA-256

known_failure_cases.description: import ledger without adding src to sys.path (python3 -I): every case fails
Floating-point money (0.1 + 0.2 compared with a 0.3 cap, -0.00)
Only the first invalid row reported
Capped categories with no rows omitted
Cap name not checked against the category rule

before_each_attempt: The studio checks the connection before starting an attempt or a replacement: an earlier request with an unknown outcome, or a daily cap without room for 2 requests, stops the qualification (state stopped, not a failure) without starting it; another request still running makes it wait
recut_note: Re-cut on 2026-11-15 before any run (PR #200 review 1): the infrastructure rule above and, for the larger benchmark, the structure check now match the rules they copy. The first cut never ran
